mechanics.claim: Ezreal blinks then the bolt fires and travels as a homing missile, so damage lands on missile arrival, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: fires a homing bolt towards the nearest enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: The bolt targets the nearest enemy to Ezreal's new location, not necessarily the original target location.
mechanics.quote: then fires a homing bolt towards the nearest enemy

mechanics.claim: Against a lone target dummy, the bolt will always strike it since it is the nearest enemy.
mechanics.quote: fires a homing bolt towards the nearest enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for 1 second

mechanics.claim: The bolt prioritizes enemies marked by Essence Flux over the nearest enemy rule.
mechanics.quote: ''Arcane Shift'' prioritizes firing at the nearest enemy marked by ''{{ai|Essence Flux|Ezreal}}''.

mechanics.claim: The ability can hit unseen targets.
mechanics.quote: ''The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability.''
